title: CNN Compilers Benchmark: Artifact for Gaps in Operator Fusion for Deep Learning Systems
description: Reproducibility artifact for the SBLP 2026 paper. It contains the benchmark implementation for TorchInductor, XLA, and TVM; pinned environments and a GPU-enabled container recipe; complete K=5 cold-process result grids with 30 ResNet and 21 Transformer cells; raw process-level timing samples; compiler-IR integrity evidence; statistical analyses; and scripts that regenerate the paper tables.
